examples.en: The Crystal Palace was an extraordinary building.
examples.zh: 水晶宫是一座非凡的建筑。

examples.en: The Crystal Palace was made of iron and glass.
examples.zh: 水晶宫由铁和玻璃建成。

examples.en: The Great Exhibition was held in 1851.
The building was made of iron.
The palace was made of iron and glass.
examples.zh: 水晶宫由铁和玻璃建成。

examples.en: Many goods were sent to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 许多货物被运到博览会上。

examples.en: Goods came from various parts of the world.
A great deal of machinery was on display.
Nasmyth's steam hammer was on show.
examples.zh: 内史密斯的蒸汽锤在展出。

examples.en: Thousands of visitors crossed the Channel.
examples.zh: 成千上万的参观者渡过英吉利海峡。

examples.en: Steam boats carried visitors across the Channel.
examples.zh: 汽船把参观者运过英吉利海峡。

examples.en: The profits were used to build museums.
examples.zh: 收益被用来建造博物馆。

examples.en: They built museums and colleges with the profits.
examples.zh: 他们用收益建造博物馆和学院。

examples.en: The profits built museums and colleges.
examples.zh: 收益建起了博物馆和学院。

examples.en: The palace was built in Hyde Park.

examples.zh: 内史密斯发明了蒸汽锤。

sentences.en: The Crystal Palace was perhaps the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century.
sentences.zh: 水晶宫也许是19世纪最不寻常的建筑。

sentences.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings, for it was made of iron and glass.
sentences.zh: 水晶宫与所有其他建筑都不一样，因为它是由铁和玻璃建成的。

sentences.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 大量货物从世界各地运到了博览会上。

sentences.en: Steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
sentences.zh: 汽船把成千上万的参观者从欧洲运过了英吉利海峡。

sentences.en: The Crystal Palace was moved to South London later, and it was burnt down in 1936.
sentences.zh: 后来水晶宫被迁到了伦敦南部，1936年被烧毁了。

article.en: The Crystal Palace was perhaps the most extraordinary building of the nineteenth century.
article.zh: 水晶宫也许是19世纪最不寻常的建筑。

article.en: It was built in Hyde Park for the Great Exhibition of 1851.
article.zh: 它是为1851年的万国博览会而建在海德公园的。

article.en: The Crystal Palace was different from all other buildings, for it was made of iron and glass.
article.zh: 水晶宫与所有其他建筑都不一样，因为它是由铁和玻璃建成的。

article.en: It was one of the biggest buildings of all time, and many people came to see it.
article.zh: 它是有史以来最大的建筑之一，许多人前来参观。

article.en: A great many goods were sent to the exhibition from various parts of the world.
article.zh: 大量货物从世界各地运到了博览会上。

article.en: There was also a great deal of machinery on display.
The most wonderful piece of machinery on show was Nasmyth's steam hammer.
article.zh: 展出的最奇妙的机器是内史密斯的蒸汽锤。

article.en: Steam boats carried thousands of visitors across the Channel from Europe.
article.zh: 汽船把成千上万的参观者从欧洲运过了英吉利海峡。

article.en: There were six million visitors in all, and the profits were used to build museums and colleges.
article.zh: 参观者总数达600万人，博览会的收益被用来建造博物馆和学院。

article.en: The Crystal Palace was moved to South London later, and it was burnt down in 1936.
article.zh: 后来水晶宫被迁到了伦敦南部，1936年被烧毁了。
